subject: Conditional remit amendment + MSA redline for Coupa onboarding
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@harborhealth.com>
Cc: procurement_ops@harborhealth.com; Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Conditional remit amendment + MSA redline for Coupa onboarding

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Quick follow-up on next steps so we can unblock procurement and Coupa registration:

Summary of ask:
- HarborHealth needs Redwood's standard MSA + order form; we've circulated a redline and have a couple of requested clarifications.
- Harbor's procurement team wants POs to be acknowledged within a window and for invoice remit to match Coupa when activated.
- Coupa enrollment timeline is uncertain on your side (you mentioned mid-November as optimistic).

To unblock billing while Coupa is in flight I'd like to propose a short conditional amendment: temporarily route invoices to the existing remit address on the order form until Coupa is live, at which point the parties will execute the agreed remit switch via the portal. Legal will capture the trigger + acceptance language so billing isn't delayed.

Can you confirm: 1) whether Harbor can accept a 48-hour PO-acknowledgement SLA in the amendment, and 2) an expected Coupa activation target (best estimate)? Also please share SOC2 evidence and the Contact for vendor enrollment in your vendor ops team (procurement_ops copied).

I've attached our current marked MSA (Harbor_MSAmarked_v3.docx) and a draft conditional amendment skeleton we can iterate on.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call with procurement + legal this week to finalize the amendment so DevOps can schedule integration. Available windows: Thu 10/21 10:00-11:00 PT, Fri 10/22 09:00-12:00 PT.

Thanks —
Priyom
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
pri@redwood.ai

Attachments: Harbor_MSAmarked_v3.docx (docx)
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@harborhealth.com>

Cc: HarborHealth Procurement <procurement_ops@harborhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Conditional remit amendment + MSA redline for Coupa onboarding

Hi Priyom —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few notes from Procurement:

- We can review your redline; procurement_ops will pull our standard PO terms and SOC2 certs and send them over.
- For PO acknowledgement: 48 hours is reasonable for standard goods/services; for first-month invoices we typically allow a 5-business-day onboarding grace, but we can accept a 48-hour SLA in the amendment for future POs if the change is explicitly tied to the portal go-live.
- Coupa timeline: our vendor onboarding lead is estimating a target activation between Nov 10–20, but that depends on ID proofing and tax doc uploads.

Attached is our procurement team's PO terms (Harbor_PO_Terms_2027.pdf). Our vendor enrollment contact is Linh Tran (linh.tran@harborhealth.com) — I'll loop her on the thread.

We can do Thu 10/21 10:00 PT — I'll accept the invite.

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager
HarborHealth
sarah.nguyen@harborhealth.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@harborhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2027 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Conditional remit amendment + MSA redline for Coupa onboarding

Sarah / Priyom —

Thanks for the context and for sharing Harbor's PO terms. I reviewed the MSA redline and drafted a short standalone amendment we can present on the call. High-level items included:

1) Conditional Remit Clause — language that allows invoices to be routed to the existing remit address until Harbor notifies Redwood (in writing) that Coupa vendor activation is complete; upon notification the parties will update the remit via the portal within 7 business days.

2) PO Acknowledgement SLA — propose 48-hour acknowledgment for routine POs; carveouts for dispute/first invoice with a 5-business-day initial window.

3) Evidence & Security — we request your SOC 2 Type II report (redacted if necessary) and an encrypted transport for any audit evidence. We'll treat evidence confidentially under the MSA's security provisions.

4) Signatory path — because Harbor's procurement prefers DocuSign routing, we included a streamline signature block and a fallback 'wet-sign' path if portal signing fails.

I've attached the draft amendment (Conditional_Remit_Amendment_v1.docx) and a summary of the specific redline callouts in the MSA (Harbor_MSAmarked_v3.docx). On the call I'll ask Legal to confirm the exact trigger language; we prefer a clear, objective trigger (portal activation email or vendor ID status update).

If Harbor is OK with the 48-hour SLA and the draft amendment text, we can prepare the DocuSign envelope during the call and expedite execution.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachments: Conditional_Remit_Amendment_v1.docx (docx), Harbor_MSAmarked_v3.docx (docx)

Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2027 08:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Conditional remit amendment + MSA redline for Coupa onboarding

Thanks all — meeting confirmed for Thu 10/21 10:00 PT (I've sent a calendar invite). For the call agenda:

1) Confirm conditional remit trigger wording and PO-ack SLA (5 minutes)
2) Confirm required security evidence delivery channel (5 minutes)
3) Walk through the draft amendment and agree on the signatory flow (15 minutes)
4) Next steps: DocuSign envelope + internal ops handoff for Coupa vendor ID (5 minutes)

Jonas: can you flag any operational gating items (SFTP vs portal CSV ingest, required field mappings) before the call? Marissa: please be ready to summarize billing and invoicing exceptions we've granted in similar customers (couple examples).

I'll prepare the HubSpot deal update after the call and kick a DocuSign envelope if we have agreement. DocuSign envelope template link and HubSpot deal are in the thread.

- Priyom

Subject: Re: Conditional remit amendment + MSA redline for Coupa onboarding

Priyom / Kimberly —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for the clear amendment language. We discussed internally and HarborHealth accepts the Conditional Remit Amendment as drafted with one small tweak: the portal activation notice should allow an internal 3-business-day buffer for our vendor ops team to complete the final mapping before the remit switch becomes effective. Suggested language: "upon Harbor's written notice of Coupa activation, the parties shall complete the remit update within 7 business days, provided Harbor has up to 3 business days to finalize vendor ops mapping after providing notice."

We signed the amendment in DocuSign and attached the envelope link here (https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EX-7a9c1f23). Anticipated Coupa activation: Nov 15 (target) — Linh will coordinate uploads next week.

I'll send a final copy of the signed amendment and our SOC2 redacted cover page to procurement_ops and Priyom after Linh confirms the vendor record.

Regards,
Sarah Nguyen

HarborHealth
